rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Food Industry Division ), 044-201-1835, 1836

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the “Wheat Industry Promotion Act” and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Wheat Industry Promotion Act” and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Scope of Wheat Industry) The term “ industry prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” in Article 2, Subparagraph 4, Item (d ) of the “Wheat Industry Promotion Act” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) means any of the industries falling under any of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Scope of Wheat Industry) The term “ industry prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” in Article 2, Subparagraph 4, Item (d ) of the “Wheat Industry Promotion Act” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) means any of the industries falling under any of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Wheat Seed Business
rows.text_en: 1. Wheat Seed Business

rows.source_ko: 2. Wheat drying industry
rows.text_en: 2. Wheat drying industry

rows.source_ko: 3. Packaging, storage, and transportation business of wheat, flour, or wheat products
rows.text_en: 3. Packaging, storage, and transportation business of wheat, flour, or wheat products

rows.source_ko: 4. Flour distribution and sales business
rows.text_en: 4. Flour distribution and sales business

rows.source_ko: 5. Research and technology development business for the expansion of supply and consumption of wheat, flour, or wheat products
rows.text_en: 5. Research and technology development business for the expansion of supply and consumption of wheat, flour, or wheat products

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Scope of Workers in the Wheat Industry) In subparagraph 5 of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Wheat Industry Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “industry prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs”refers to the industries under subparagraphs 1 and 2 of Article 2.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Scope of Workers in the Wheat Industry) In subparagraph 5 of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Wheat Industry Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “industry prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the industries under subparagraphs 1 and 2 of Article 2.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Fact-finding Survey) ① The fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be conducted by the following methods:
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Fact-finding Survey) ① The fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be conducted by the following methods:

rows.source_ko: 1. Periodic Survey: A survey conducted every five years for use in establishing the basic plan for the development of the wheat industry pursuant to Article 5 of the Act .
rows.text_en: 1. Periodic Survey: A survey conducted every five years for use in establishing the basic plan for the development of the wheat industry pursuant to Article 5 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 2. Ad-hoc Inspection: An inspection conducted when deemed necessary for the formulation and implementation of policies to foster the wheat industry.
rows.text_en: 2. Ad-hoc Inspection: An inspection conducted when deemed necessary for the formulation and implementation of policies to foster the wheat industry.

rows.source_ko: ② The contents of the fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:
rows.text_en: ② The contents of the fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. Cultivated Wheat Varieties and Production Status
rows.text_en: 1. Cultivated Wheat Varieties and Production Status

rows.source_ko: 2. Contract Cultivation Volume and Storage Status of Wheat
rows.text_en: 2. Contract Cultivation Volume and Storage Status of Wheat

rows.source_ko: 3. Matters concerning wheat production costs, prices by distribution stage, and supply and demand
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning wheat production costs, prices by distribution stage, and supply and demand

rows.source_ko: 4. Current Status of Processing, Distribution, and Sales of Wheat or Flour
rows.text_en: 4. Current Status of Processing, Distribution, and Sales of Wheat or Flour

rows.source_ko: 5. Current Status of Manufacturing, Distribution, and Sales of Wheat Products
rows.text_en: 5. Current Status of Manufacturing, Distribution, and Sales of Wheat Products

rows.source_ko: 6. Other matters requiring investigation for the establishment of policies necessary to foster the wheat industry
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters requiring investigation for the establishment of policies necessary to foster the wheat industry

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Designation of Educational and Training Institutions, etc.) ①The application for designation of an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form .
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Designation of Educational and Training Institutions, etc.) ① The application for designation of an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② The designation certificate for an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .
rows.text_en: ② The designation certificate for an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the designation and operation of educational and training institutions shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the designation and operation of educational and training institutions shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Priority Support for Project Costs) A party to a contract cultivation agreement eligible for priority support for project costs pursuant to Article 11 of the Act shall meet the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Priority Support for Project Costs) A party to a contract cultivation agreement eligible for priority support for project costs pursuant to Article 11 of the Act shall meet the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. The wheat cultivation area must be 500,000 square meters or more.
rows.text_en: 1. The wheat cultivation area must be 500,000 square meters or more.

rows.source_ko: 2. A corporation or organization must have 25 or more members engaged in the wheat industry pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree .
rows.text_en: 2. A corporation or organization must have 25 or more members engaged in the wheat industry pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree .

rows.source_ko: Article 7 (Designation of Wheat Production and Distribution Complex, etc.) ①The application for designation of a wheat production and distribution complex pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form .
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Designation of Wheat Production and Distribution Complex, etc.) ① The application for designation of a wheat production and distribution complex pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② In cases where a wheat production and distribution complex is designated pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , the following matters must be posted on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
rows.text_en: ② In cases where a wheat production and distribution complex is designated pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , the following matters must be posted on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Name, location, and area of ​​the wheat production and distribution complex
rows.text_en: 1. Name, location, and area of ​​the wheat production and distribution complex

rows.source_ko: 2. Total cultivated area of ​​wheat
rows.text_en: 2. Total cultivated area of ​​wheat

rows.source_ko: 3. Designated date
rows.text_en: 3. Designated date

rows.source_ko: ③ In the event that the designation of a wheat production and distribution complex is revoked pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the following matters must be posted on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
rows.text_en: ③ In the event that the designation of a wheat production and distribution complex is revoked pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the following matters must be posted on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Name, location, and area of ​​the wheat production and distribution complex
rows.text_en: 1. Name, location, and area of ​​the wheat production and distribution complex

rows.source_ko: 2. Designation Date and De-designation Date
rows.text_en: 2. Designation Date and De-designation Date

rows.source_ko: 3. Reasons for Revocation of Designation
rows.text_en: 3. Reasons for Revocation of Designation

rows.source_ko: Article 8 (Quality Standards and Quality Control of Wheat) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairsshall establish quality standards for wheat regarding quality, variety purity, protein content, etc., in accordance with Article 14 of the Act .
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Quality Standards and Quality Control of Wheat) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall establish quality standards for wheat regarding quality, variety purity, protein content, etc., in accordance with Article 14 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall, in accordance with Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Act , establish quality control measures for each stage of production and distribution of wheat for the quality control of wheat.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall, in accordance with Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Act , establish quality control measures for each stage of production and distribution of wheat for the quality control of wheat.

rows.source_ko: ③ Detailed matters concerning the quality standards and quality control measures for wheat pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .
rows.text_en: ③ Detailed matters concerning the quality standards and quality control measures for wheat pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .

rows.source_ko: Article 9 (Approval for Establishment of an Organization) ①The application for approval of the establishment of an organization pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form .
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Approval for Establishment of an Organization) ① The application for approval of the establishment of an organization pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② In Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, “documents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, “documents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. List of assets
rows.text_en: 1. List of assets

rows.source_ko: 2. Business Plan and Income and Expenditure Budget
rows.text_en: 2. Business Plan and Income and Expenditure Budget

rows.source_ko: 3. List of Officers and Acceptance of Appointment by Officers
rows.text_en: 3. List of Officers and Acceptance of Appointment by Officers

rows.source_ko: 4. Minutes of the Inaugural General Meeting (if the founder is a corporation, documents proving the decision regarding the incorporation of the corporation)
rows.text_en: 4. Minutes of the Inaugural General Meeting (if the founder is a corporation, documents proving the decision regarding the incorporation of the corporation)

rows.source_ko: ③ The Articles of Association and guidance and supervision of organizations established pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be governed by the “Rules on the Establishment and Supervision of Non-Profit Corporations under the Jurisdiction of the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the Heads of Agencies under His/her Authority” .
rows.text_en: ③ The Articles of Association and guidance and supervision of organizations established pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be governed by the “Rules on the Establishment and Supervision of Non-Profit Corporations under the Jurisdiction of the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the Heads of Agencies under His/her Authority” .

rows.source_ko: Article 10 (Criteria for Determining Domestic Wheat, etc.) Domestic wheat, domestic wheat flour, or domestic wheat processed products for which the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the head of a local government may request priority purchase pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be those for which the country of origin of the relevant wheat is indicated as “Domestic,” “Domestic,” or the name of the city, province, or city, county, or district of the domestic production area, in accordance with Article 5 of the Act on Labeling of Country of Origin of Agricultural and Fishery Products, etc. <Amended Dec. 31, 2021>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Criteria for Determining Domestic Wheat, etc.) Domestic wheat, domestic wheat flour, or domestic wheat processed products for which the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the head of a local government may request priority purchase pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be those for which the country of origin of the relevant wheat is indicated as “Domestic,” “Domestic,” or the name of the city, province, or city, county, or district of the domestic production area, in accordance with Article 5 of the Act on Labeling of Country of Origin of Agricultural and Fishery Products, etc. <Amended Dec. 31, 2021>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ③ Omitted

rows.source_ko: ④ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Wheat Industry Promotion Act is amended as follows.
rows.text_en: ④ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Wheat Industry Promotion Act is amended as follows.

rows.text_en: In Article 10, “the Act on the Labeling of Origin of Agricultural and Fishery Products” shall be changed to “the Act on the Labeling of Origin, etc. of Agricultural and Fishery Products”.
